sth.text: Selenia, a spirit bound to the service of Crovax's father, flies away when Crovax shatters the artifact binding her, and he is cursed to destroy all that he loves.
On Rath, Crovax sees Selenia leading an attack against the Weatherlight and breaks down, and he strikes her down, so that she shatters into shards that warp him into a vampire.
